faq_heading: New Westminster schools: your questions answered

blocks.text: The BC Ministry of Education and Child Care school list shows 24 schools with a New Westminster street address: 18 public schools and 6 independent schools. It also shows 4 college and university campuses. In that list, 5 schools marked as offering French Immersion, 3 alternate programs and 2 online schools.
Public schools here are run by School District 40 (New Westminster). Count by district: School District 40 (New Westminster): 18.
Alternate programs, continuing education centres and online schools that have a street address sit under "other public schools and programs"; the level of every school is read from its name.
Public secondary schools with a New Westminster address: New Westminster Secondary and Power Alternate Secondary School.

The Ministry file marks these New Westminster schools as offering French Immersion: Herbert Spencer Elementary, Lord Tweedsmuir Elementary, New Westminster Secondary, École Glenbrook Middle School and École Qayqayt Elementary.

Independent schools listed for New Westminster include Al-Hidayah School, John Knox Christian - Secondary Campus, PALS Autism Society (School Program), Purpose Independent Secondary School, Urban Academy Junior and Urban Academy Senior.
Before an offer, ask the district which school serves the exact street address.

faq.q: How many schools are in New Westminster, BC?
faq.a: The BC Ministry of Education and Child Care list shows 24 schools with a New Westminster street address: 18 public schools and 6 independent schools. The count includes alternate programs and online schools that have a street address.

faq.q: Which school district covers New Westminster?
faq.a: Public schools with a New Westminster address are run by School District 40 (New Westminster).

faq.q: How do I find the catchment school for a New Westminster address?
faq.a: Ask School District 40 (New Westminster) to confirm it for the exact street address.
